title: City Council District 4
statement: Ivy Hill is moving in two directions: sentiment and retail vitality improved, while the crime index rose and remains above the city figure. I’m not adding another proposal this week: the board already shows several distinct Ivy Hill initiatives, and the current record does not establish which, if any, is ready for further action. I’ll ask the Clerk to restore the missing directive text before responding on its merits; a list of directive IDs alone is not enough to make a responsible commitment.

payload.text: This directive requests a final authorization vote during the C105 legislative session. That session is past; I cannot call the vote retroactively. The current brief does not show Baylight Phase II as a petition-pending row on my board, so I will not represent that a vote can be called now.
